notes:
Inbound SMB lead focused on automating support workflows. Primary ask: reliably turn multi-message ticket threads into a compact JSON payload (summary, category, severity, suggested reply, follow-up actions) that can be piped into their existing ticketing system via tool calling. Key fragments from calls: 
- 'We need structured JSON outputs we can map directly to our create-ticket API'
- 'Tool calling needs to be deterministic for ticket create/close flows; we will not accept hallucinated actions.'
- Cost sensitivity: small monthly budget but willing to scale if latency and quality meet SLOs.
- Model preference: leaning towards small/efficient open models for cost, but open to Redwood hosted curated models if fallbacks and cost controls exist.
- Latency/throughput: conversational front-line flows require ~<200ms p95 for single-turn summaries, bulk nightly summarization can be async. Target peak concurrent requests ~20-50 RPS.
- Monitoring: wants per-route token / latency breakdown and simple rollback on quality regressions.
- Security: SSO for admin console, audit logs for agent actions, retention controls to auto-delete raw tickets after 90 days.
Sales notes: partner-led self-serve vibe; good fit for Redwood Hosted API free credits -> quick POC. Legal is the main gating item (SOC2 evidence + retention SLA). Technical team curious about examples for structured-output enforcement (schema validation + reject-on-nonconformant).
